title: One line of feed/news/mra-news-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl
description: One news article of day D. Every field is present on every line: an empty list is [], a missing value is null. MERGE on id; the line with the greatest (digest_date, updated_at) is the current one. The text fields are in Vietnamese. Fields from enrichment onward are produced by a language model, the fields before it by deterministic code.

schema_version.description: Version of the file layout; 2 is the layout described here. It rises only when a field changes type or meaning or is dropped. A new field does not change it.

digest_date.description: Day D this line belongs to, the same date as in the file name. Day D is a window between two morning cuts (about 04:40 Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh), not a calendar day.

id.description: Stable article id: mi- followed by 8 hex characters of a hash of the normalized article URL. An article keeps its id on every day it appears. Key for MERGE.

title.description: Headline as published, usually in Vietnamese.

description.description: Lead paragraph (sapo) from the feed, as published. null when the feed gave none.

source_url.description: URL of the article on the publisher site. For an item found through Google News whose publisher link could not be resolved, the Google News link.

source_name.description: Name of the publisher, e.g. CafeF, VnExpress.

source_domain.description: Domain of the publisher. For a Google News item, the domain named in the feed entry. null when unknown.

language.description: Language of the article. vi = Vietnamese; en = English.

published_at.description: When the publisher says the article was published, with UTC offset. null when the feed gave no time.

published_date.description: Date of published_at in Vietnam time (UTC+7). null when published_at is null.

collected_at.description: When the collector first saw the article.

updated_at.description: Time of the stored version of the article used for this line. When one id appears in several files, the line with the greatest (digest_date, updated_at) is the current one.

feeds.description: Ids of the feeds (RSS feeds or Google News queries) in which the article was seen. One article can come from several.

tier.description: Reliability tier of the source, fixed in configuration and not judged per article. 1 = the body that issues the figures (regulator, official publisher); 2 = established news outlet; 3 = any other source.

content_status.description: Outcome of fetching the full text. ok = the full text is in content_md; failed = the page could not be fetched; no_text = the page was fetched but holds no article body; paywalled = the publisher is behind a paywall and was not fetched; unresolved = a Google News link that did not lead to the publisher page; skipped_budget = not fetched because the monthly fetch budget was reached; listed = headline only, never fetched by design.

fetch_via.description: How the full text was fetched. http = a plain HTTP request; firecrawl = a rendering service, used where plain HTTP cannot get the page. null when nothing was fetched.

content_md.description: Full text of the article as Markdown, exactly as the collector stored it. null unless content_status is ok.

prefilter.description: Result of the keyword filter that runs before any model. candidate = passed the filter; unrelated = out of scope by the keyword rules, kept in the file with category news_unrelated and not processed further.

llm_use.description: Whether the full text of this source may be given to the language model. When false the model saw only the title and the lead: summary is then the lead (summary_source sapo), and an analysis, when there is one, is written from that lead alone.

cluster_id.description: Copy cluster: the id of the earliest article among near-identical copies of one text (syndication). Equals id when the article has no copy.

dedup_suspect.description: Ids of other articles the collector suspected of reporting the same event. A hint only; the decision is in event_key.

enrichment.description: How far the model layer processed this article. full = labelled and summarized; triage_only = labelled (category, topic, relevance) but not summarized; raw = not processed, every model field is empty.

llm_run_id.description: Id of the model run that produced the model fields, in the form llm-YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM. null when enrichment is raw.

event_key.description: Event id: ev- followed by 10 hex characters. Articles that report the same event (same actors, same action, same time) share one event_key. They mostly share a digest_date too, but an article can take the event_key of an article of an earlier day that reports the same event. null when enrichment is raw.

representative.description: true for exactly one article of each event_key, the one that stands for the event; false for the other articles of that event, which may sit in a later digest_date than the representative. Only a representative is scored: join on event_key across days to give the scores of an event to all its articles. When the first article of the event was never enriched, no article has true for that event_key. null when enrichment is raw.

category.description: Categories from meta/taxonomy.json (macro, micro, retail, other), the primary one first; or news_unrelated alone for an article out of scope. Empty when enrichment is raw.

subcategory.description: Subcategories from meta/taxonomy.json, each under one of the categories of the article, the primary one first. Empty for news_unrelated and when enrichment is raw.

topic.description: The event in a few plain Vietnamese words, at most 120 characters. null when the title says nothing usable or enrichment is raw.

segment.description: Business segments of the bank the article concerns. RBG = retail banking: individuals and the retail business; CIBG = corporate and institutional banking: corporate clients and the credit portfolio. Can hold both, or be empty.

relevance.description: How much the bank needs this article, judged by the model from the title and the lead. 3 = changes operating conditions or a key market now; 2 = clearly bears on the business or a client sector, worth reading in full; 1 = background; 0 = unrelated. null when enrichment is raw.

summary.description: Facts the article states, one sentence per element, in Vietnamese. Nothing here is inferred. Empty when the article was not summarized.

summary_source.description: Where summary comes from. llm = written by the model from the full text; sapo = a lead written by the publisher, used when llm_use is false: the lead paragraph of the feed or, when the feed gave none, the meta description of the page, taken only when it is short enough to be a lead (600 characters) and never cut. null when summary is empty.

entities.description: Organizations, people, places and instruments the article names. Empty when the article was not summarized.

name.description: The name as written in the article.

type.description: Kind of entity. bank = commercial bank; company = any other company; regulator = state body or regulator; person = an individual; place = country, province or city; index = market index; currency = currency or currency pair; commodity = commodity such as gold or oil; other = anything else.

metrics.description: Names of the indicators the article reports, in snake_case, e.g. deposit_rate, lending_rate, policy_rate, credit_growth. A free vocabulary, not a fixed list.

figures.description: Numbers quoted from the text of the article. They are what the article says, NOT official data; official rates are in the rates file.

metric.description: Name of the indicator, in snake_case, as in metrics.

entity.description: Who or what the number is about. null when it is about no one in particular.

unit.description: Unit of value, e.g. pct, VND, bn_VND, USD.

period.description: Period the number covers, e.g. 2026-Q3. null when the article does not say.

as_of.description: Date the number refers to. null when the article does not say.

direction.description: The main move the article reports. up = rising; down = falling; flat = unchanged; new = something new (a product, a rule, a deal); n/a = no direction applies. null when the article was not summarized.

event_date.description: Date the event happened or takes effect, as the article states it; not the publication date. null when the article does not say.

analysis.description: Short assessment written by the model for every representative event of relevance 2 or more that has a summary, longer for the day top events. An opinion, not a fact. Markdown without headings. null for every other article, and for an event whose model batch failed. Days before 2026-10-15 have one only for their top 15 events.

sentiment_corporate.description: Model judgement, not data: direction of the effect of the event on the corporate and institutional banking business of the bank. From -1 (clear loss) through 0 (no direction) to 1 (clear gain). null when the article was not scored or the event does not touch this lens.

impact_corporate.description: Model judgement, not data: size of the effect on the corporate and institutional banking business, in either direction. 1 = hardly touches it; 2 = indirect, slow or unclear; 3 = indirect through a clear channel; 4 = direct on a core sector or a major client group; 5 = direct and large. null exactly when sentiment_corporate is null.

sentiment_general.description: Model judgement, not data: direction of the effect of the event on the SME, household and overall business of the bank. From -1 (clear loss) through 0 (no direction) to 1 (clear gain). null when the article was not scored or the event does not touch this lens.

impact_general.description: Model judgement, not data: size of the effect on the SME, household and overall business, in either direction. 1 = hardly touches it; 2 = small or slow effect; 3 = effect through consumption, jobs or one sector; 4 = strong effect on households or on pricing; 5 = system-wide change for every customer. null exactly when sentiment_general is null.

scoring_version.description: Version of the scoring rules in force when the article was scored; compare scores across versions with care. A value with both lenses null means the article was scored and found to touch neither lens. null when the article was not scored.
